visual_style.overall: Extremely premium, elegant, minimalistic, sophisticated luxury.
visual_style.animations: framer-motion for smooth reveal, slow parallax, staggered list entrances.
visual_style.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-8, p-12, py-24. Containers with borders need p-8 minimum.

sections_layout.hero: Full screen (h-screen). Background image with bg-[#111111]/70 overlay. Centered text. Headline: 'Every Bottle Tells A Story'. Gold accent line below headline. Primary & Secondary CTA buttons.
sections_layout.what_we_do: Grid layout (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-8). Service cards with glassmorphism.
sections_layout.showcase: Bento grid layout for featured customizations. Mix of large and small images.
sections_layout.why_purefit: Grid layout for features. Minimal icons (lucide-react or phosphor), gold color. 2-column or 4-column layout.
sections_layout.process_timeline: Vertical line connecting 4 steps. Step numbers in gold circles. Scroll-triggered animation.
sections_layout.industries: Marquee or horizontal scroll of industry categories.
sections_layout.social_proof: 3 large counters (5000+, 100+, 100%). Big serif numbers in Gold.
sections_layout.gallery: Masonry or balanced grid. Category filter buttons at top.
sections_layout.quote_form: Shadcn form. File upload field. Dark theme form inputs.
sections_layout.contact: 2-column layout. Contact details + form on one side, Map on the other.

testing_instructions.data_testid_rules: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the deep forest green (#0B3D2E) acts as the primary dominant color with #111111 used for backgrounds. Gold (#D4AF37) should be used for accents, buttons, icons, and text highlights. Implement smooth Framer Motion scroll animations to emphasize the luxury feel. Avoid completely sharp corners unless explicitly intended; use subtle rounded corners (e.g., rounded-lg). Embed data-testid on all interactive elements. Follow pure Javascript (.js/.jsx), do not use Typescript.
